NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: 02.18 15:18 pst An internet service provider near Dark Ages servers reports that they are having a router issue, and that they are fixing it. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
